strengths: Comprehensive site structure and content outlines visible in document object model

issues.description: The page renders as raw unstyled HTML with broken layouts, plain blue links, unformatted text hierarchy, and default bullet lists.
issues.recommendation: Fix stylesheet asset paths and ensure CSS files load correctly across all environments.

issues.issue: Broken Image Assets and Placeholder Graphics
issues.description: Multiple key media elements, project showcases, and feature images fail to load, displaying broken alt text and missing media boxes.
issues.recommendation: Update image asset URLs, optimize image paths, and provide appropriate fallback placeholders.

issues.description: The 'Our Latest Project' and 'Latest posts & articles' sections feature dark grey body text on a black background, failing WCAG color contrast standards completely.
issues.recommendation: Use high-contrast white or light-grey text colors on dark section backgrounds.

issues.description: The header navigation renders as an unstyled unordered list, causing poor user navigation and broken visual structure.
issues.recommendation: Apply flexbox/grid layout and CSS navigation styles to format links horizontally in a header header container.

issues.description: The 'Why choose us' section contains generic Lorem Ipsum placeholder text ('There are many variations of passages...').
issues.recommendation: Replace all dummy filler copy with actual value propositions for the business.

target.text: There are many variations of passages of form, by injected humour, or randomised words which don't look even.
